summary: Defines a BGP Outbound Route Filter type called the Covering Prefixes ORF. A router can use it to ask a neighbor to send only routes that cover certain prefixes. It is useful in virtual hub-and-spoke VPNs and in BGP/MPLS Ethernet VPN networks.

eli5.summary: A shop tells its supplier, only send me the catalogs that cover the things I actually sell. Less paper arrives, so less needs filing.
